entendimento: The specification changes from single-cycle RV32I to single-cycle RV32IM. Eight register-register M instructions must be decoded and completed on the current instruction’s rising edge. Division by zero and signed-division overflow have defined results. The CPU’s external interface and all RV32I behavior remain unchanged.

immediate_generator.mudanca: Retain the five immediate formulas, but review and validate the block as part of the RV32IM decomposition. M instructions introduce no immediate format.

m_unit.mudanca: Add combinational execution of MUL, MULH, MULHSU, MULHU, DIV, DIVU, REM, and REMU.

decoder.mudanca: Add m_enable for OP instructions with funct7=0000001 and any of the eight funct3 values. Retain RV32I decoding and unsupported-instruction behavior.

cpu.mudanca: Instantiate m_unit and select its result for register writeback when m_enable is asserted. Preserve existing PC, RV32I datapath, reset, and external-bus behavior.
